name: Source Collaboration Review Notification
description: Notifies the assigner when they have a review to approve by a collaborator who is configuring a source
subject: $assignedUser has submitted a draft of the $referenceName source
body:
Source configuration draft ready for review

Dear $__recipient.name,

$assignedUser has submitted a draft of the $referenceName source configuration. You can approve the configuration or request changes, then publish the draft to create the source.

Review the draft on the $referenceName configuration page.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
